topic: Day 1 — carousel — Life isn't a straight line, stop grading yourself like it is

slides.text: You're grading a zigzag against a straight line nobody's walking.
The version you're comparing to is edited. Yours is happening live.
Feeling behind is a measurement error, not a life error.
You're not [behind], just off someone's clock.

caption:
Progress zigzags for everyone — we just compare our real path to everyone else's edited highlight reel. That comparison was rigged before it started.

Follow for one of these a day.
